nationalDexEnrichment.note: Per-species nationalDex is PokéAPI pokemon id for artwork URLs (regional dexNumber is separate). Run npm run sync:national-dex to refresh.

habitatGuide.summary: Each Pokémon appears only when you build habitats that match its Specialty needs, Preferred Environment (Bright, Dark, Warm, Cool, Moist, Dry), favorable time of day, and weather. Place the required habitat recipe materials, then assign areas as the game prompts.
steps: Pick a habitat template (e.g. Tall Grass, Campsite, Fishing Spot) from the in-game builder.
Gather and place every required material listed for that habitat tier.
Match the species’ Preferred Environment and Specialty (see each species entry).
Adjust time-of-day and weather when the Pokédex entry lists them as conditions.
For legendaries, expect stricter recipes and single-habitat exclusivity (plan endgame resources first).

exampleHabitatRecipes.requiredMaterialsSummary: Includes base "Tall grass" blocks; some species need add-ons like bench with greenery or hydrated variants.
Water-adjusted tall grass variant — see in-game recipe for exact item counts.
